page_title: AUX 0-1 MAR | Auxerre v Marseille 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Michael Murillo (Marseille) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+3' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
90+1' It looks like Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Bastien won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
89' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
87' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Danny Namaso (Auxerre) duly receives a yellow card.
85' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
84' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) replaces Elisha Owusu.
84' Today's match ends for Marvin Senaya who will be replaced by Lamine Sy (Auxerre).

83' A pass travels right across the box to Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Geronimo Rulli denies him with a decent save.
81' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
80' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
79' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
78' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle after Emerson (Marseille) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pol Lirola (Marseille).
77' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
76' Auxerre take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
71' The foul by Sekou Mara (Auxerre) was seen by Benoit Bastien who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
69' Substitution. Gideon Mensah makes way for Sekou Mara (Auxerre).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) will replace Josue Casimir.
67' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
65' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
64' Igor Paixao (Marseille) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post.
63' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Angel Gomes and he is replaced by Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille).
63' Substitution. Robinio Vaz walks off the pitch and Igor Paixao (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
59' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
58' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
56' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
55' Angel Gomes (Marseille) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

54' Angel Gomes (Marseille) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Marseille can continue in their attacking effort.

53' Michael Murillo (Marseille) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Marseille win a corner kick.
53' Benoit Bastien blows for a foul after Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
52' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is about to take a corner kick.
51' Celebrations are cut short for Auxerre as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
50' The Auxerre players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Bastien makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
49' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
49' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads high over the bar from close in.
48' Emerson (Marseille) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.

48' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Marseille will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+6' Emerson (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+4' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45+4' Emerson (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45+3' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
45+3' The game is interrupted. Michael Murillo (Marseille) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
45+1' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Christophe Pelissier is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Lasso Coulibaly suffers an injury and Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) comes on.
41' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) picks up an injury.
39' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
36' Emerson (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
34' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
34' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Angel Gomes (Marseille) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Angel Gomes (Marseille) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Marseille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

24' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Bastien with no other option than to blow for a foul.
23' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benoit Bastien who sees an offensive foul.
22' Angel Gomes (Marseille) takes the corner.
20' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Danny Namaso (Auxerre). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
16' Michael Murillo (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
16' Michael Murillo (Marseille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
15' A lofted cross from Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
12' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
9' Foul! Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
8' Michael Murillo (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
6' A pass from Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is intercepted by Geronimo Rulli and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has started.
Auxerre will kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
